owner.name: Krishna GSVV
owner.title: I'm Krishna GSVV — CS student, builder & hackathon champion
owner.bio: B.Tech Computer Science graduate of Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham (CGPA: 8.63/10, graduated Jul 2026), based in India and open to relocation. I build full-stack applications and AI systems that solve real problems — from browser extensions to deep learning pipelines. Right now I'm a software intern at Fission Labs, working an AI and Python stack. I started in core Python, moved to FastAPI to build services, backed those with PostgreSQL and designed the REST APIs on top of them, and I'm now on retrieval-augmented generation — including docs-rag, a pipeline that answers strictly from the documents it is given and cites the passages it used. I've competed at the national level and won five times: 1st at the IIT Hyderabad Pathway Hackathon, 1st runner-up at IIT Delhi CodeHive (₹1,00,000), 2nd runner-up at Tredence InfinityAI 2025 (₹2,00,000), 1st runner-up at ITM Gwalior's Code Kurukshetra with MomCare (₹35,000), and 1st at the Microsoft Imagine Cup campus round — ₹3.55L in prizes across 2025. On the research side, my deep learning work on diabetic retinopathy prediction is published on IEEE, and the EquiLens bias-detection corpus is released on Zenodo. I maintain open-source tools people actually use — cSpell Sync has 2,500+ VS Code Marketplace installs, and I'm LeetCode 150+ with HackerRank 5-star Python & SQL. My stack centers on React, Python, Node.js, and cloud (AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, OCI Certified Architect Associate). Whether it's a VS Code extension, an ML pipeline, or a blockchain gateway — I care about code that's clean, fast, and worth shipping.

experience.title: Software Intern
description: Software internship on an AI and Python stack, working up from the language itself to retrieval-augmented generation.
Began in core Python, then moved to FastAPI to build services.
Backed those services with PostgreSQL and designed the REST APIs on top of them.
Now working on RAG: retrieval pipelines that answer from a chosen set of documents rather than from the model alone.
Built docs-rag, a strictly grounded RAG pipeline that answers only from the documents it is given and cites the passages it used.

projects.name: RanobeGemini
projects.description: Browser extension enhancing web novel translations using Google's Gemini AI. Transforms poorly translated content on popular novel sites with one click.

projects.name: ToxicGuard_AI
projects.description: ToxiGuard AI is a browser extension that detects and censors toxic language in real-time using TensorFlow.js. It offers fine-grained controls, visual feedback, auto-censor, adjustable sensitivity, and respects user privacy.

projects.name: EquiLens
projects.description: AI Bias Detection Platform for LLMs via Ollama. Interactive CLI with corpus generation, multi-metric auditing, statistical analysis & visualization. Features enhanced auditors, dynamic concurrency, resume capability & rich progress tracking.

projects.name: Save-Sync
projects.description: VS Code Extension to save your project at working save points.

projects.name: CFlair-Counter
projects.description: Ultra-efficient serverless view counter with admin panel and SVG badges. Optimized for Cloudflare's free tier with headless telemetry tracking.

projects.name: the-pensive-index
projects.description: Library-first fanfiction discovery platform with hierarchical tagging and intelligent prompt generation. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Spec-Driven Development.

projects.name: cspell-sync
projects.description: cspell-sync: VS Code extension syncing project spelling dictionaries with global settings for consistent spell checking across workspaces.

projects.name: Facial-Emotion-Detector
projects.description: Facial emotion detection using MediaPipe and machine learning. Extract facial landmarks, train models, and classify emotions in real-time from images and videos.

projects.name: ActionsCounter
projects.description: GitHub Actions workflow tracker and analytics dashboard for CI/CD monitoring, deployment tracking, and webhook integration.

projects.name: SignLanguageDetector
projects.description: Sign Language Detector is a real-time ISL recognition system. It uses OpenCV and MediaPipe for hand tracking, a machine learning classifier for gesture recognition, and a Flask web interface for live inference.

projects.name: BreachCheck
projects.description: BreachCheck is a tool designed to help users check if their email addresses or passwords have been involved in known data breaches. It leverages APIs from various breach database aggregators to provide users with information about their potential exposure.

projects.name: PulseWard-HMS
projects.description: Licensed proprietary software developed under a commercial licence. The repository is private, so this entry records the work rather than linking to public source — details available on request.

projects.name: HiveXplore
projects.description: HiveXplore is a beginner-friendly app built on Hive blockchain that introduces newcomers to decentralized social media without technical barriers. Features simplified authentication, intuitive posting tools, and guided experiences as an educational gateway for blockchain beginners.

projects.name: dev-prune
projects.description: Reclaim disk space from idle Git repositories. A Rust CLI that deletes node_modules, .venv, target and vendor only after the project's own package manager proves a lockfile can rebuild them.

projects.name: docs-rag
projects.description: A strictly grounded RAG pipeline over documents you choose. It answers only from the sources you give it, cites the passages it used, and refuses when those documents do not support an answer - a constraint verified mechanically rather than merely requested in a prompt.

projects.name: Code-Ledger
projects.description: Auto-commit every accepted LeetCode, GeeksforGeeks, Codeforces, NeetCode and takeuforward solution to your own GitHub repo - with AI code review, a live analytics dashboard, a knowledge graph, streaks and badges, bulk history import and cross-device sync. No servers, no accounts, no payments.

projects.name: LoginLens
projects.description: Browser extension that answers "which account did I use here?" — it records the provider and MFA method per site, entirely on-device. No passwords, no account, no backend, no telemetry.

projects.name: Chronos-Ledger
projects.description: Self-hosted campus attendance and timetable platform. Geofenced check-in, a real-time WebSocket hub and offline-first PWA behaviour, deployable to a campus in one Docker command.

projects.name: Vectra-180
projects.description: Dual-fisheye dashcam and stereoscopic depth engine for the Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5 — two 180° sensors calibrated into a single depth map alongside synchronised IMU telemetry.
